name: Gangster TokenVault drip credits more than its pool after idle periods
summary: TokenVault.distribute() credited stakers with the drip pool's daily rate multiplied by all the time since the last payout, without capping it at the pool's balance. The vault had been idle for 302 days, so the attacker donated 1 BTCB to the drip pool, deposited a small stake, triggered the distribution and harvested, recovering the donation plus other stakers' BTCB, 4.0 years after deployment.
